Tarun Gupta | tarun.gupta203@example.com | +91 9745425948
Kolkata. Open to relocating to Pune or Mumbai.
Product Designer at Dream11, Sep 2024 - Jun 2026
Led end-to-end design for a new in-app tournament flow that increased match participation by 12% within three months by iterating high-fidelity screens and interactive prototypes using Figma. Conducted weekly generative and usability sessions to validate concepts with targeted user groups, synthesizing findings into prioritized product changes and measurable success criteria. Collaborated with product managers and engineers via Git-based workflows to ship features on two-week sprints, reducing handoff issues by improving component documentation and maintaining a reusable component library. Drove UI/UX improvements across onboarding and payment journeys leading to a 9% drop in drop-off rate through focused prototyping and A/B testing.

Skills:
Figma, UI/UX, Prototyping, User Research, Git

Education:
MBA (Finance), NMIMS
